tābhya eva catuḥṣaṣṭiparyantaṃ śakticakrakam // 254
3.d:
पूजयेद्भैरवात्माख्यां योगिनीद्वादशावृताम् ।
ताभ्य एव चतुःषष्टिपर्यन्तं शक्तिचक्रकम् ॥ 254
3.m:
having the nature of Bhairava, surrounded by twelve yoginīs, should be worshipped.
Beginning from these alone, the circle of powers extending up to sixty-four,

3.s:
ekārataḥ samārabhya sahasrāraṃ pravartate /
tāsāṃ ca kṛtyabhedena nāmāni bahudhāgame // 255
3.d:
एकारतः समारभ्य सहस्रारं प्रवर्तते ।
तासां च कृत्यभेदेन नामानि बहुधागमे ॥ 255
3.m:
commencing with one spoke, proceeds up to a thousand spokes.
And in the scripture their names are manifold according to the division of their functions,

3.s:
upāsāśca dvayādvaitavyāmiśrākārayogataḥ /
śrīmattraiśirame tacca kathitaṃ vistarādbahu // 256
3.d:
उपासाश्च द्वयाद्वैतव्यामिश्राकारयोगतः ।
श्रीमत्त्रैशिरमे तच्च कथितं विस्तराद्बहु ॥ 256
3.m:
and their modes of worship, according to their association with dual, non-dual, and mixed forms.
And in the venerable Traiśirasa that has been explained at great length.

3.s:
iha no likhitaṃ vyāsabhayāccānupayogataḥ /
tā eva nirmalāḥ śuddhā aghorāḥ parikīrtitāḥ // 257
3.d:
इह नो लिखितं व्यासभयाच्चानुपयोगतः ।
ता एव निर्मलाः शुद्धा अघोराः परिकीर्तिताः ॥ 257
3.m:
It has not been written here for fear of prolixity and due to its lack of utility [here].
Those very [powers], stainless and pure, are renowned as the Aghorā [powers].

3.s:
ghoraghoratarāṇāṃ tu sotṛtvācca tadātmikāḥ /
sṛṣṭau sthitau ca saṃhāre tadupādhitrayātyaye // 258
3.d:
घोरघोरतराणां तु सोतृत्वाच्च तदात्मिकाः ।
सृष्टौ स्थितौ च संहारे तदुपाधित्रयात्यये ॥ 258
3.m:
Yet, because they also engender the Ghorā and Ghoratarā [powers], they are identical with them.
In creation, maintenance, and dissolution, and in the transcendence of that triad of limiting conditions,

3.s:
tāsāmeva sthitaṃ rūpaṃ bahudhā pravibhajyate /
upādhyatītaṃ yadrūpaṃ taddvidhā guravo jaguḥ // 259
3.d:
तासामेव स्थितं रूपं बहुधा प्रविभज्यते ।
उपाध्यतीतं यद्रूपं तद्द्विधा गुरवो जगुः ॥ 259
3.m:
the enduring form of those very [powers] is divided in many ways.
The teachers have proclaimed that the form transcending limiting conditions is twofold:

3.s:
anullāsādupādhīnāṃ yadvā praśamayogataḥ /
praśamaśca dvidhā śāntyā haṭhapākakrameṇa tu // 260
3.d:
अनुल्लासादुपाधीनां यद्वा प्रशमयोगतः ।
प्रशमश्च द्विधा शान्त्या हठपाकक्रमेण तु ॥ 260
3.m:
either from the non-manifestation of limiting conditions, or through their pacification.
And pacification is twofold: by gentle quieting, but [also] through the process of sudden digestion.

3.s:
alaṃ grāsarasākhyena satataṃ jvalanātmanā /
haṭhapākapraśamanaṃ yattṛtīyaṃ tadeva ca /
upadeśāya yujyeta bhedendhanavidāhakam // 261
3.d:
अलं ग्रासरसाख्येन सततं ज्वलनात्मना ।
हठपाकप्रशमनं यत्तृतीयं तदेव च ।
उपदेशाय युज्येत भेदेन्धनविदाहकम् ॥ 261
3.m:
Enough with that perpetually blazing nature known as the taste of devouring!
That pacification through sudden digestion which is the third,
consuming the fuel of duality, is indeed fitting for instruction.

3.s:
nijabodhajaṭharahutabhuji bhāvāḥ sarve samarpitā haṭhataḥ /
vijahati bhedavibhāgaṃ nijaśaktyā taṃ samindhānāḥ // 262
3.d:
निजबोधजठरहुतभुजि भावाः सर्वे समर्पिता हठतः ।
विजहति भेदविभागं निजशक्त्या तं समिन्धानाः ॥ 262
3.m:
Forcibly offered into the fire of the belly of one's own consciousness,
all entities abandon the partition of duality, kindling it by their own power.

3.s:
haṭhapākena bhāvānāṃ rūpe bhinne vilāpite /
aśnantyamṛtasādbhūtaṃ viśvaṃ saṃvittidevatāḥ // 263
3.d:
हठपाकेन भावानां रूपे भिन्ने विलापिते ।
अश्नन्त्यमृतसाद्भूतं विश्वं संवित्तिदेवताः ॥ 263
3.m:
When the differentiated form of entities has been dissolved through sudden digestion,
the deities of consciousness consume the universe converted into the nectar [of oneness].

3.s:
tāstṛptāḥ svātmanaḥ pūrṇa hṛdayaikāntaśāyinam /
cidvyomabhairavaṃ devamabhedenādhiśerate // 264
3.d:
तास्तृप्ताः स्वात्मनः पूर्ण हृदयैकान्तशायिनम् ।
चिद्व्योमभैरवं देवमभेदेनाधिशेरते ॥ 264
3.m:
Having become satiated, they recline non-differently in the god Bhairava,
the ether of consciousness, who rests in the solitary retreat of their own full heart.

3.s:
evaṃ kṛtyakriyāveśānnāmopāsābahutvataḥ /
āsāṃ bahuvidhaṃ rūpamabhede'pyavabhāsate // 265
3.d:
एवं कृत्यक्रियावेशान्नामोपासाबहुत्वतः ।
आसां बहुविधं रूपमभेदेऽप्यवभासते ॥ 265
3.m:
Thus, through immersion in functions and actions, and through the multiplicity of names and forms of worship,
their manifold form shines forth, even while non-difference persists.

3.s:
āsāmeva ca devīnāmāvāpodvāpayogataḥ /
ekadvitricatuṣpañcaṣaṭsaptāṣṭanavottaraiḥ // 266
3.d:
आसामेव च देवीनामावापोद्वापयोगतः ।
एकद्वित्रिचतुष्पञ्चषट्सप्ताष्टनवोत्तरैः ॥ 266
3.m:
And through the permutation of insertion and omission of these very goddesses,
progressing by ones, twos, threes, fours, fives, sixes, sevens, eights, and nines,

3.s:
rudrārkānyakalāsenāprabhṛtirbhedavistaraḥ /
alamanyena bahunā prakṛte'tha niyujyate // 267
3.d:
रुद्रार्कान्यकलासेनाप्रभृतिर्भेदविस्तरः ।
अलमन्येन बहुना प्रकृतेऽथ नियुज्यते ॥ 267
3.m:
there is an extensive differentiation—the Rudras, the suns, other energies, armies, and so forth.
Enough with much else; now let what is relevant be undertaken.

3.s:
saṃvidātmani viśvo'yaṃ bhāvavargaḥ prapañcavān /
pratibimbatayā bhāti yasya viśveśvaro hi saḥ // 268
3.d:
संविदात्मनि विश्वोऽयं भाववर्गः प्रपञ्चवान् ।
प्रतिबिम्बतया भाति यस्य विश्वेश्वरो हि सः ॥ 268
3.m:
This entire manifold collection of entities shines as a reflection
within the self that is consciousness—he in whom it so shines is indeed the Lord of the universe.

3.s:
evamātmani yasyedṛgavikalpaḥ sadodayaḥ /
parāmarśaḥ sa evāsau śāṃbhavopāyamudritaḥ // 269
3.d:
एवमात्मनि यस्येदृगविकल्पः सदोदयः ।
परामर्शः स एवासौ शांभवोपायमुद्रितः ॥ 269
3.m:
He in whose self such a non-conceptual, ever-arisen
reflective awareness exists, is sealed by the Śāmbhava means.

3.s:
pūrṇāhantāparāmarśo yo'syāyaṃ pravivecitaḥ /
mantramudrākriyopāsāstadanyā nātra kāścana // 270
3.d:
पूर्णाहन्तापरामर्शो योऽस्यायं प्रविवेचितः ।
मन्त्रमुद्राक्रियोपासास्तदन्या नात्र काश्चन ॥ 270
3.m:
This reflective awareness of full I-consciousness which has been examined here—
no other mantras, mudrās, actions, or forms of worship are required in this regard.

3.s:
bhūyobhūyaḥ samāveśaṃ nirvikalpamimaṃ śritaḥ /
abhyeti bhairavībhāvaṃ jīvanmuktyaparābhidham // 271
3.d:
भूयोभूयः समावेशं निर्विकल्पमिमं श्रितः ।
अभ्येति भैरवीभावं जीवन्मुक्त्यपराभिधम् ॥ 271
3.m:
Resorting again and again to this non-conceptual immersion,
he attains the state of Bhairava, which is known by another name as liberation in life.

3.s:
ita eva prabhṛtyeṣā jīvanmuktirvicāryate /
yatra sūtraṇayāpīyamupāyopeyakalpanā // 272
3.d:
इत एव प्रभृत्येषा जीवन्मुक्तिर्विचार्यते ।
यत्र सूत्रणयापीयमुपायोपेयकल्पना ॥ 272
3.m:
Beginning only from this point is liberation in life investigated,
where even this scheme of means and goal is formulated.

3.s:
prāktane tvāhnike kācidbhedasya kalanāpi no /
tenānupāye tasminko mucyate vā kathaṃ kutaḥ // 273
3.d:
प्राक्तने त्वाह्निके काचिद्भेदस्य कलनापि नो ।
तेनानुपाये तस्मिन्को मुच्यते वा कथं कुतः ॥ 273
3.m:
In the preceding daily lesson, however, there was not even a notion of duality;
therefore, in that absence of means, who is liberated, or how, or from what?

3.s:
nirvikalpe parāmarśe śāmbhavopāyanāmani /
pañcāśadbhedatāṃ pūrvasūtritāṃ yojayedbudhaḥ // 274
3.d:
निर्विकल्पे परामर्शे शाम्भवोपायनामनि ।
पञ्चाशद्भेदतां पूर्वसूत्रितां योजयेद्बुधः ॥ 274
3.m:
In this non-conceptual reflective awareness named the Śāmbhava means,
the wise person should apply the fiftyfold division formulated earlier.

3.s:
dharāmevāvikalpena svātmani pratibimbitām /
paśyanbhairavatāṃ yāti jalādiṣvapyayaṃ vidhiḥ // 275
3.d:
धरामेवाविकल्पेन स्वात्मनि प्रतिबिम्बिताम् ।
पश्यन्भैरवतां याति जलादिष्वप्ययं विधिः ॥ 275
3.m:
Seeing even the earth non-conceptually reflected in one's own self,
one attains the state of Bhairava; this same rule applies also to water and the rest,

3.s:
yāvadante paraṃ tattvaṃ samastāvaraṇordhvagam /
vyāpi svatantraṃ sarvajñaṃ yacchivaṃ parikalpitam // 276
3.d:
यावदन्ते परं तत्त्वं समस्तावरणोर्ध्वगम् ।
व्यापि स्वतन्त्रं सर्वज्ञं यच्छिवं परिकल्पितम् ॥ 276
3.m:
until, in the end, the supreme principle transcending all coverings,
pervasive, autonomous, omniscient, which is conceived as Śiva—

3.s:
tadapyakalpitodārasaṃviddarpaṇabimbitam /
paśyanvikalpavikalo bhairavībhavati svayam // 277
3.d:
तदप्यकल्पितोदारसंविद्दर्पणबिम्बितम् ।
पश्यन्विकल्पविकलो भैरवीभवति स्वयम् ॥ 277
3.m:
seeing even that reflected in the mirror of unconstructed, noble consciousness,
free from conceptual constructs, one becomes Bhairava oneself.

3.s:
yathā raktaṃ puraḥ paśyannirvikalpakasaṃvidā /
tattaddvāraniraṃśaikaghaṭasaṃvittisusthitaḥ // 278
3.d:
यथा रक्तं पुरः पश्यन्निर्विकल्पकसंविदा ।
तत्तद्द्वारनिरंशैकघटसंवित्तिसुस्थितः ॥ 278
3.m:
Just as someone, seeing a red object in front of him with non-conceptual consciousness,
stands firmly in the undivided, unitary awareness of the pot through those various senses,

3.s:
tadvaddharādikaikaikasaṃghātasamudāyataḥ /
parāmṛśansvamātmānaṃ pūrṇa evāvabhāsate // 279
3.d:
तद्वद्धरादिकैकैकसंघातसमुदायतः ।
परामृशन्स्वमात्मानं पूर्ण एवावभासते ॥ 279
3.m:
so, reflecting on his own self through the aggregate of earth and the rest, individually and collectively,
he shines forth as completely full.

3.s:
matta evoditamidaṃ mayyeva pratibimbitam /
madabhinnamidaṃ ceti tridhopāyaḥ sa śāmbhavaḥ // 280
3.d:
मत्त एवोदितमिदं मय्येव प्रतिबिम्बितम् ।
मदभिन्नमिदं चेति त्रिधोपायः स शाम्भवः ॥ 280
3.m:
"This has arisen from me alone; it is reflected in me alone;
and this is non-different from me": such is the threefold Śāmbhava means.

3.s:
sṛṣṭeḥ sthiteḥ saṃhṛteśca tadetatsūtraṇaṃ kṛtam /
yatra sthitaṃ yataśceti tadāha spandaśāsane // 281
3.d:
सृष्टेः स्थितेः संहृतेश्च तदेतत्सूत्रणं कृतम् ।
यत्र स्थितं यतश्चेति तदाह स्पन्दशासने ॥ 281
3.m:
This formulation of creation, maintenance, and dissolution has been made [by him].
He declared that in the Spanda teaching: "wherein it rests and whence [it arises]".

3.s:
etāvataiva hyaiśvarya saṃvidaḥ khyāpitaṃ param /
viśvātmakatvaṃ cetyanyallakṣaṇaṃ kiṃ nu kathyatām // 282
3.d:
एतावतैव ह्यैश्वर्य संविदः ख्यापितं परम् ।
विश्वात्मकत्वं चेत्यन्यल्लक्षणं किं नु कथ्यताम् ॥ 282
3.m:
For by this much alone the supreme sovereignty of consciousness
and its identity with the universe have been proclaimed; what other characteristic could possibly be stated?

3.s:
svātmanyeva cidākāśe viśvamasmyavabhāsayan /
sraṣṭā viśvātmaka iti prathayā bhairavātmatā // 283
3.d:
स्वात्मन्येव चिदाकाशे विश्वमस्म्यवभासयन् ।
स्रष्टा विश्वात्मक इति प्रथया भैरवात्मता ॥ 283
3.m:
"I am illuminating the universe in the sky of consciousness, within myself alone;
I am the creator, identical with the universe": through this expansion, one is Bhairava.

3.s:
ṣaḍadhvajātaṃ nikhilaṃ mayyeva pratibimbitam /
sthitikartāhamasmīti sphuṭeyaṃ viśvarūpatā // 284
3.d:
षडध्वजातं निखिलं मय्येव प्रतिबिम्बितम् ।
स्थितिकर्ताहमस्मीति स्फुटेयं विश्वरूपता ॥ 284
3.m:
"The entire aggregate of the six paths is reflected in me alone;
I am the agent of maintenance": this universal form becomes manifest.

3.s:
sadoditamahābodhajvālājaṭilatātmani /
viśvaṃ dravati mayyetaditi paśyanpraśāmyati // 285
3.d:
सदोदितमहाबोधज्वालाजटिलतात्मनि ।
विश्वं द्रवति मय्येतदिति पश्यन्प्रशाम्यति ॥ 285
3.m:
"In my self, tangled with the flames of ever-arisen great awakening,
this universe dissolves in me": seeing thus, one becomes pacified.

3.s:
anantacitrasadgarbhasaṃsārasvapnasadmanaḥ /
ploṣakaḥ śiva evāhamityullāsī hutāśanaḥ // 286
3.d:
अनन्तचित्रसद्गर्भसंसारस्वप्नसद्मनः ।
प्लोषकः शिव एवाहमित्युल्लासी हुताशनः ॥ 286
3.m:
"I am Śiva alone, the burner of the dream-abode of saṃsāra,
which contains within itself endless varieties": such is the flashing fire.

3.s:
jagatsarvaṃ mattaḥ prabhavati vibhedena bahudhā tathāpyetadrūḍhaṃ mayi vigalite tvatra na paraḥ /
taditthaṃ yaḥ sṛṣṭisthitivilayabhekīkṛtivaśādanaṃśaṃ paśyetsa sphurati hi turīyaṃ padabhitaḥ // 287
3.d:
जगत्सर्वं मत्तः प्रभवति विभेदेन बहुधा तथाप्येतद्रूढं मयि विगलिते त्वत्र न परः ।
तदित्थं यः सृष्टिस्थितिविलयभेकीकृतिवशादनंशं पश्येत्स स्फुरति हि तुरीयं पदभितः ॥ 287
3.m: The entire universe originates from me in various divisions; nevertheless, it is grounded in me; when this is dissolved, there is nothing other [than me]. / Thus, he who, by uniting creation, maintenance, and dissolution, sees [them] as partless, flashes forth indeed all around the fourth state.

3.s:
tadasminparamopāye śāmbhavādvaitaśālini /
ke'pyeva yānti viśvāsaṃ pasmeśena bhāvitāḥ // 288
3.d:
तदस्मिन्परमोपाये शाम्भवाद्वैतशालिनि ।
केऽप्येव यान्ति विश्वासं पस्मेशेन भाविताः ॥ 288
3.m:
Therefore, in this supreme means characterized by the Śāmbhava non-duality,
only a few attain faith, being graced by the Supreme Lord.

3.s:
snānaṃ vrataṃ dehaśuddhirdhāraṇā mantrayojanā /
adhvaklṛptiryāgavidhirhomajapyasamādhayaḥ // 289
3.d:
स्नानं व्रतं देहशुद्धिर्धारणा मन्त्रयोजना ।
अध्वक्लृप्तिर्यागविधिर्होमजप्यसमाधयः ॥ 289
3.m:
Bathing, vows, bodily purification, mental concentration, application of mantras,
arrangement of the path, sacrificial rites, fire offerings, recitations, and meditative absorptions—

3.s:
ityādikalpanā kāpi nātra bhedena yujyate /
parānugrahakāritvamatrasthasya sphuṭaṃ sthitam // 290
3.d:
इत्यादिकल्पना कापि नात्र भेदेन युज्यते ।
परानुग्रहकारित्वमत्रस्थस्य स्फुटं स्थितम् ॥ 290
3.m:
any such mental construct is not applicable here through differentiation;
that the one established here bestows supreme grace is clearly established.

3.s:
yadi tādṛganugrāhyo daiśikasyopasarpati /
athāsau tādṛśo na syādbhavabhaktyā ca bhāvitaḥ // 291
3.d:
यदि तादृगनुग्राह्यो दैशिकस्योपसर्पति ।
अथासौ तादृशो न स्याद्भवभक्त्या च भावितः ॥ 291
3.m:
If such a candidate for grace approaches the spiritual guide—
yet if he should not be of that kind, though imbued with devotion to Bhava,

3.s:
taṃ cārādhayate bhāvitādṛśānugraheritaḥ /
tadā vicitraṃ dīkṣādividhiṃ śikṣeta koviṃdaḥ // 292
3.d:
तं चाराधयते भावितादृशानुग्रहेरितः ।
तदा विचित्रं दीक्षादिविधिं शिक्षेत कोविंदः ॥ 292
3.m:
and worships him, prompted by grace of that kind that has arisen [in him],
then the wise [master] should teach the manifold rite of initiation and the rest.

3.s:
bhāvinyo'pi hyupāsāstā straivāyānti niṣṭhitim /
etanmayatvaṃ paramaṃ prāpyaṃ nirvarṇyateśivam // 293
3.d:
भाविन्योऽपि ह्युपासास्ता स्त्रैवायान्ति निष्ठितिम् ।
एतन्मयत्वं परमं प्राप्यं निर्वर्ण्यतेशिवम् ॥ 293
3.m:
For even future forms of worship find their completion in this very [state];
this supreme state of identity with this [reality] to be attained is described as Śiva.

3.s: iti kathitamidaṃ suvistaraṃ paramaṃ śāmbhavamātmavedanam // 294
3.d: इति कथितमिदं सुविस्तरं परमं शाम्भवमात्मवेदनम् ॥ 294
3.m: Thus has this supreme Śāmbhava self-knowledge been expounded in full detail.
